description: Every interactive element and every value the E2E suite reads, with the same id on every client. Web: data-testid attribute (Flutter web: Semantics identifier). iOS: accessibilityIdentifier. Android: resource-id or testTag. Desktop: the platform's automation id. Values are read as text; numbers appear without unit, a trailing % is allowed.

ids.habit.new: Opens the form for a new habit
ids.today.habit.<habitId>: Row of a habit on Today, due or not due
ids.today.habit.<habitId>.name: Value: the habit's name
ids.today.habit.<habitId>.check: Check button for targetPerDay 1, pressed state = done
ids.today.habit.<habitId>.count: Value: today's count for targetPerDay above 1
ids.detail.edit: Opens the form for this habit
ids.detail.name: Value: the habit's name
ids.detail.rate30: Value: rate of the last 30 days in percent
ids.detail.chart: Chart of the rate by weeks or months
ids.stats.rate: Value: rate of the current week or month in percent
ids.stats.compare.<habitId>: Value: the habit's rate of the last 30 days in percent, in display order
ids.habits.<habitId>.name: Value: name in the list of habits, archived ones included
ids.habits.<habitId>.edit: Opens the form for an active habit
ids.form.name: Name input
ids.settings.import: Import a JSON or CSV file
ids.login.register: Creates an account with the entered email and password
